purpose: Deterministic student-facing current-affairs quality audit. Hard errors protect structural/evidence contracts; semantic review flags never auto-attach laws, delete relations, or promote trend claims.

presentation_tiers.strong_historical_support: At least one strong historical match. This still does not mean exam prediction.
presentation_tiers.medium_historical_relation: No strong match, but at least one medium historical relation. Present as related review evidence, not a strong trend claim.
presentation_tiers.concept_observation: Only concept-level or no historical relation. Present as event/professional observation, not a supported exam trend.

non_goals: Do not infer or attach a law from keywords alone.
Do not remove a historical relation automatically because it lacks a strong match.
Do not convert source count or trend score into an exam probability.
Do not modify Official Core, source allowlists, production data, or student UI from this audit.
